name: iter_scarcity_longrun
description: SCARCITY LONG RUN - does the compounding guided advantage at pool_deficit 0.98 (see iter_scarcity_confirm) keep growing, saturate, or revert over a loop 2.5x longer? The winning cell (alpha 0.5, n_train 30, n_select 100) run to K=20 under the two policies that matter there: Constant (keep focusing - the deficit never heals) and the severity-adaptive gate (should keep alpha up on its own while the detected contrast persists). 15 seeds.
